receipt.public_excerpt: All variations cause the LLM to fail.

evidence_items.explanation: Ullman reports failures across four unexpected-transfer variations and four unexpected-contents variations in the contemporary GPT-3.5 system. These establish recurring failures, although the selected examples do not estimate their prevalence across all possible tasks.
This contemporary study reports substantial success and limits any suggestion of general inability. Its different task battery does not negate the recurring failures in Ullman's variations.

unresolved_gaps: The evidence does not establish a representative failure rate across the full range of theory-of-mind problems.
